date: June 1097 - on the march from Nicaea

character.name: Bohemond of Taranto
character.role: Norman Prince, leader of the Italo-Norman crusader contingent

feats.name: Silver-Tongued Courtier
feats.description: A gift for saying the right thing at court. The GM should let a well-turned compliment or veiled threat land harder than the words alone would justify. Mechanically: +2 on Oration checks.

liabilities.name: Pride of Lineage
liabilities.description: On any failed Cunning or Presence check involving a named rival, automatically add 1 enmity pip (enforced by the application, not GM discretion).

liabilities.name: Blood Debt
liabilities.description: A feud, owed or owing, that predates this campaign. At least one enmity relationship should start (or quickly develop) at an elevated level because of it.

godfrey_of_bouillon.note: Fellow crusade leader - more pious and idealistic than you, generally a straight dealer.

tancred.note: Your nephew and most loyal lieutenant - ambitious in his own right, but genuinely on your side.

adhemar_of_le_puy.note: Papal legate - the expedition's real unifying moral authority.

alexios_i.note: Byzantine Emperor - the crusaders swore him oaths of fealty for reclaimed territory; whether either side honors that is very much in question.

raymond_of_toulouse.note: Wealthiest and most senior crusade leader - a real rival for leadership and, later, for Antioch itself.

yaghi_siyan.note: Seljuk governor of Antioch - not yet engaged, but the city ahead is his to defend.

oath_to_alexios.description: Sworn fealty to Emperor Alexios I - reclaimed former Byzantine territory is to be returned to him.
